card.summary: H.R. 1702, known as the JUDGES Act of 2025, addresses judicial understaffing by creating 64 new U.S. district court judgeships across multiple states over a ten-year period, establishing 63 permanent positions and 1 temporary position. It also expands court locations in California and Texas, requires GAO reports on judicial workloads and detention space, and mandates online public access to the Judicial Conference's biennial judgeship recommendations.
